title: Implementation Consultant RIM
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role

Veeva Systems is looking for individual leaders with consulting and system implementation experience and a passion for helping customers optimize their regulatory data and document management processes.
Veeva’s Vault RIM suite is the industry’s only unified software solution that provides fully integrated regulatory information management (RIM) capabilities, including data and document management, submission publishing, and archival on a single cloud-based platform.
As a member of our Professional Services team, you will be responsible for understanding our customers’ global regulatory needs, translating requirements into solution design, and configuring our cloud-based solution for managing regulatory information across the enterprise.
There is no work location requirement (remote position) within the EU/UK if a candidate is in close proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements. Qualified EU/UK-based candidates are encouraged to apply.
What You'll Do

• Implement software and design solutions with our Veeva Regulatory suite (Veeva Registrations, Veeva Submissions, Veeva Submissions Archive, Veeva Submissions Publishing) at life sciences customers

• Lead configuration requirements workshops, design, and document, as well as prototype and deploy solutions

• Program and project management, including resource planning, leading and motivating a cross-functional team

• Communicate between the project team, customer, and internal stakeholders

Requirements

• 3+ years in technology implementation services, in life sciences or healthcare

• Technical abilities and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design, configure and implement a RIM solution

• Ability to collaborate and communicate excellently with diverse stakeholders

• Team player with strong organization skills and an ability to work hard in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to travel as required by the business

Nice to Have

• Consulting experience, working with a major system integrator or software vendor

• Knowledge of drug development, Regulatory Affairs, or Regulatory Operations

• Experience in life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements

• Fluency in one or more of the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

title: Director, Technical Support Engineering
description:
Forming Our Future together
FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle - from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.
Rooted in our core values - Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People - we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.
Shift:
The regular hours for this position are day shift. Job Description:
The Director of Technical Support Engineering is responsible for leading FormFactor's global technical support engineering function, serving as the highest level of product and application expertise within the service organization. This leader drives technical escalation management, service readiness, engineering collaboration, and customer issue resolution across a global network of field, regional, and factory service teams.

The role provides strategic leadership for product technical support, advanced troubleshooting, failure analysis, NPI service readiness, service documentation, training standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and Global Service Operations, the Director ensures customers receive world-class technical support throughout the product lifecycle while enabling scalable and profitable service delivery.
Key Responsibilities:

Technical Support Leadership

• Lead the global Technical Support Engineering organization supporting all FormFactor product lines.

• Establish and manage a structured multi-level technical escalation process.

• Serve as executive owner for complex customer escalations and systemic product performance issues.

• Drive rapid root-cause analysis and corrective actions to minimize customer downtime.

• Establish service engineering standards, best practices, and troubleshooting methodologies.

Product Technical Expertise

• Develop and maintain deep product expertise across hardware, software, applications, and manufacturing processes.

• Oversee advanced troubleshooting, failure analysis, and corrective action programs.

• Act as the technical bridge between Service, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Product Management.

• Drive continuous improvements in product reliability, serviceability, and customer experience.

Global Service Readiness

• Develop global support strategies to enable successful product deployment across all regions.

• Ensure technical consistency across site support centers, regional service centers, factory repair centers, and partner organizations.

• Create standardized troubleshooting procedures, service documentation, and repair methodologies.

• Define service qualification criteria prior to field deployment.

• Partner with field service leadership to ensure effective knowledge transfer and capability development.

Training and Knowledge Management

• Own global technical training strategy and certification programs.

• Develop technical competency models and career development pathways.

• Build scalable knowledge management systems and technical documentation infrastructure.

• Ensure field engineers and regional teams have the technical expertise required to support customers independently.

Operational Excellence

• Define and measure technical support KPIs including:

• Escalation closure time

• Root cause completion rate

• First-time resolution rate

We are looking for a senior strategy leader who can both help shape the strategy and drive execution. title: Software Engineer, Grok Connectors
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer on the Grok Connectors team at SpaceXAI, you'll build the integrations that let Grok, Cursor and Grok Bot do real work inside the tools people use every day: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar and Drive, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, GitHub, Slack, finance accounts, and a fast-growing marketplace of third-party MCP plugins. You'll architect, implement, and deploy features end to end, from OAuth sign-in and token handling, to tool schemas and reliability across hundreds of millions of tool calls, to the cards and approval flows users see on web, desktop, and mobile. You'll work directly with enterprise customers and partners to ship connectors that large organizations can trust.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have an entrepreneurial spirit and love creating outsized business impact.

- You want AI agents to be genuinely useful, by connecting them to real data and real actions safely.

- You have deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC and of large provider APIs like Google Workspace and Microsoft Graph, or you're excited to become the expert.

- You care about reliability: concurrency, retries, rate limits, and observability. You fix root causes, not symptoms.

- You let data decide what to work on. You size user impact from logs and metrics, and you measure error rates before and after every fix.

- You're strong in TypeScript and comfortable shipping across backend services and client UI in a large codebase.

- You enjoy working with customers, partners, QA, and support, and can answer a security review question as clearly as you can fix a bug.

- Bonus: experience with the MCP protocol, Rust, Kubernetes and multi-cloud deployments, enterprise security and compliance (ZDR, audit logs, Conditional Access), or building LLM agents for automation.

SAMPLE PROJECTS INCLUDE

- Building an automated triage system that pulls user reports from feedback channels, groups them by root cause with user-impact estimates, files issues, and starts a first-pass coding agent on each fix

- Redesigning OAuth token refresh so concurrent requests never burn a single-use refresh token and mark a working connector as disconnected

- Cutting hundreds of thousands of daily tool-call errors by generating tool definitions from vendors' published API specs, fixing argument mapping, and adding batch tools

- Shipping Gmail and Outlook draft, reply, and attachment flows, with approval cards so an agent never sends an email without the user's sign-off

- Launching new partner connectors, from debugging a partner's OAuth metadata to rollout and adoption metrics

- Making connectors work for enterprise and single-tenant deployments: custom certificate authorities, Entra Conditional Access, admin controls, and compliance reviews with large financial institutions

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Research Engineer
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Research Engineer to join Encord's ML team. You'll work on robotics, computer vision and multimodal research in data curation, annotation, evaluation and quality control, with successful work going into the core product.

We face a variety of interesting research problems across the full data life-cycle, including annotation, quality control, verification and curation. We are looking to strengthen our team to build upon and extend our market-leading platform. The kind of problems we solve are constantly evolving alongside the needs of our frontier customers, including many of the leading robotics and physical AI teams. Join us as we leverage our massive flow of proprietary data on our journey to develop generalised solutions applicable across diverse multi-modal tasks.

 

What you'll do

- Form hypotheses, design experiments, and drive original research on open problems from leading robotics and AI customers

- Research and prototype agentic workflows which can handle multimodal inputs and diverse customer ontologies

- Advance our work on data curation and model evaluation

- Tackle egocentric video understanding, from captioning to deeper 3d understanding

- Build working prototypes to test ideas end to end, then partner with our ML systems and Product Engineering teammates to bring them into the platform

- Help shape our longer-term research direction and bring the most relevant ideas from the field back to the team

- Publish research papers and present your work at conferences and workshops

 

Who we're looking for

- A builder with a research mindset. You can take an open-ended problem, form a hypothesis and get to a working prototype without a detailed spec.

- A first-principles problem solver. You lean on strong fundamentals rather than surface-level familiarity with the latest trends.

- A big-picture thinker. You're excited by ambitious, longer-term problems and know how to break them into steps.

- A multiplier. You raise the level of the team around you by shaping research direction, mentoring others and turning findings into decisions.

 

Experience requirements

- A PhD in computer vision, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience

- A strong background in computer vision and multimodal ML, whether in traditional CV, modern VLMs and embedding models, or both

- Clear evidence of independent research, such as publications, a thesis, open-source work or applied research where you owned the original contribution

- Solid mathematical foundations in statistics, probability and linear algebra

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, and experience running experiments end-to-end

- A genuine interest in data-centric AI: curation, evaluation and data quality

- Bonus: experience applying LLM-based agents to visual tasks, or working with video, 3D or other complex data types

 

We’ll start reviewing applications from 1 November 2026. It may take a little while to hear back, but every application will get proper consideration.

 

Why Encord

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture - most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Daily company lunches

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

title: Biology Teacher
description:
Laurel Springs School, a subsidiary of Spring Education Group , a WASC-accredited school, is a pioneer in online private school education since 1991. Laurel Springs provides flexible and personalized learning experiences online for students in kindergarten through 12th grade and beyond.
About the Role:
Laurel Springs School is seeking an experienced, passionate, and innovative Biology educator to join our dynamic Science Department. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Biology and the capability to teach standard Biology courses to students in grades 9-12. This individual will lead weekly, engaging, synchronous lessons for Biology students, provide targeted academic support, and actively contribute to curriculum review and development. The successful candidate will also create meaningful enrichment opportunities to deepen student understanding and engagement with Biology concepts. A commitment to academic excellence, student-centered instruction, and creative online teaching strategies is essential. Candidates must have exceptional communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with students and guardians in a fully online, asynchronous learning environment that includes regular opportunities for live interaction. This full-time, 12-month remote position requires collaboration with the Science Academic Department Chair and fellow educators to ensure a cohesive and rigorous science program. Educators must be available during business hours (Eastern Time) to grade assignments, provide feedback, support students, contribute to curriculum projects, share ideas to enhance the program, and participate in meetings, office hours, and one-on-one student sessions.
General Description of Position:
A full-time teacher (grades 6-12) at Laurel Springs is a full-time, 12-month position that reports to an Academic Department Chair. Full-time teachers are responsible for direct academic support of a roster of students who are engaged in primarily asynchronous academic courses. Teachers grade and provide responsive feedback to students in the Learning Management System, meet individually with students and families, and provide warm encouragement, coaching, tutoring, and enhanced learning opportunities to students as needed. Teachers also participate in curriculum and program development, live virtual Workshops, virtual clubs/activities, and other duties as needed. This is a highly collaborative role since teachers work closely with their departments and other LSS teachers and staff. Teachers must be available during business hours (Eastern Time) to support students, collaborate with colleagues, attend meetings, and offer individual student appointments. The information in this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned, including work in other areas to cover absences or relief to equalize peak work periods or otherwise balance the workload.
Job Duties:
Duties include, but are not limited to:

• Advance the mission of the school by providing high-quality, positive, proactive asynchronous and synchronous student learning through the LSS online learning management system and other learning platforms.

• Actively monitor the academic progress of each assigned student and intervene as needed to ensure mastery and timely completion of enrollments.

• Provide substantive, motivating, personalized, timely, and constructive feedback for all student assignments.

• Support the curriculum team with content creation and course reviews as assigned.

• Communicate proactively and responsively with students, parents, counselors, staff, and administrators via email, phone, video conference, and any other communication tool

title: Senior Director, Development - ECD and MCED Products
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Join Natera as the Senior Director of Development for our Early Cancer Detection (ECD) and Multi-Cancer Early Detection (MCED) portfolio. You will take ownership of product development strategy and execution, guiding Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and cell-free DNA-based (cfDNA) In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) products from feasibility through FDA Premarket Approval (PMA) and post-market support. Every test represents a real person, and you will build an organization of scientific contributors and managers to deliver robust clinical tools. You will establish priorities, allocate resources, and represent development with the FDA and executive leadership, ensuring that scientific rigor and data drive all regulatory and portfolio decisions.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Define and own the multi-year assay development strategy and technical lifecycle for the ECD and MCED portfolio, in alignment with corporate and R&D strategy

• Take accountability for the phase-gated execution of all ECD and MCED programs, overseeing the development, design verification, and validation of NGS-based cancer detection IVD devices using cfDNA, methylation and other analyte classes.

• Set team priorities, allocate people, budget, and laboratory resources, and make or recommend go/no-go decisions to executive leadership

• Establish the analytical verification and validation strategy for the portfolio to ensure robust assays transfer seamlessly to commercial manufacturing

• Partner with clinical, medical, and biostatistics leaders to support approvable pivotal and prospective study design, statistical analysis plans, and performance claims for screening-population use in both the ECD and MCED intended-use claims

• Define regulatory pathways and evidence requirements for PMA submissions for ECD and MCED in an evolving regulatory landscape. Be facile in representing the Development approach and activities in senior-level engagement with the FDA (e.g., pre-submission meetings and advisory panels, as applicable) and accountable for the analytical performance data packages supporting each submission

• Build, retain, and mentor a leadership team of directors, managers, and scientists, optimizing the organization’s budget and external vendor partnerships

• Think team by partnering directly across research, bioinformatics, biostatistics, software, clinical, regulatory, and commercial functions to deliver design-controlled IVD products in a highly cross-functional environment 

• Communicate portfolio status, risks, and tradeoffs to executive leadership and drive alignment on enterprise priorities  

• Ensure the organization operates within Natera’s QMS and all applicable guidance (ISO 13485:2016, FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 14971, IEC 62304, etc), and partner with Quality to maintain audit readiness and strengthen design control practices

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree (PhD, MD, or equivalent) in Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 7+ years of experience in IVD or diagnostic device development under design controls

• 7+ years of experience directing scientific or technical organizations, with 5+ years managing senior managers or directors

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent development programs, with full accountability for budget, resource allocation, and prioritization

• Deep technical expertise with complex NGS-based diagnostic assays, including assay design, analytical validation, and transfer to a commercial laboratory

• Demonstrated leadership of the technical and performance evidence for at least one FDA premarket submission (PMA, De Novo, or equivalent high-complexity IVD approval) for an NGS-based device, including senior-level FDA interactions

• Experience in liquid biopsy or molecular diagnostics for clinical oncology, specifically cfDNA-based detection of low-abundance signals at high speci

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. ABOUT THE TEAM

The Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team at Anduril designs and manufactures solid rocket motors and propulsion systems for the next generation of missiles and munitions. RMS runs a vertically integrated energetics operation - from propellant chemistry and mixing through case fabrication, assembly, and test. We move fast in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment, and we depend on accurate, real-time inventory to keep production lines building.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Inventory Analyst is responsible for managing and optimizing inventory levels to support production schedules while minimizing the costs of scrap, excess and obsolescence. This role will oversee the health of inventory across materials, quality, and production - including energetic and shelf-life-sensitive chemicals unique to a rocket motor environment. The candidate will analyze usage trends, lead cycle counting programs, monitor variances and resolve discrepancies to ensure inventory integrity in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

• Oversee electronic cycle counts and physical audits to maintain near-perfect record accuracy.

• Collaborate with other manufacturing stakeholders to support operational continuity and efficient forecasting and planning.

• Track shelf-life and expiration on energetic and hazardous materials - ammonium perchlorate (AP), propellant chemicals, and controlled CHM-coded consumables - and flag lots approaching removal, repack, or retest dates before they impact the line.

• Analyze consumption trends and clear-to-build coverage against active work orders to surface shortages and long-lead risk before they block production.

• Monitor MRB and quarantine aging, dormant and dead stock, and warehouse capacity utilization, and recommend disposition or consolidation.

• Validate inventory striped to the correct project and task charge codes, and flag material at risk from expired project dates.

• Build and maintain self-service dashboards and reports that give production, quality, and program teams a live view of inventory health.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Science or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Senior Partnership Manager

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Distribution Partnerships team’s mission is taking Airbnb out to the world; working with a range of partners to embed Airbnb in highly trusted and contextually relevant environments to meet guests where they already plan and book their travel, experiences, and services.

The team owns partnerships end to end, from initial ideation, strategy, engagement, and agreement through product launch and ongoing relationship management. Within it, the Business Development (BD) segment owns the front end of the partnership lifecycle: defining strategy, identifying and recruiting partners, structuring commercial agreements, and setting the foundation for long-term partnership success. BD works hand in hand with Partner Management, which grows, measures, and continuously improves each partnership after launch. This role owns partner management for a portfolio of live distribution partners, with approximately 70% of time on day-to-day management and strategic development of existing partners and 30% supporting the team on new partners and renewals, and is growing to become an end to end partnerships leader.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will carry each deal through launch and into long-term growth, establishing the measurement, forecasting, and feedback loops that let the wider team scale the program globally.

Our partnerships are powered by a portfolio of products that are still being built (embedded booking, points earn and pay with points, embeds, and a partner portal), so you will work closely with Product and Engineering on what partners need and what we can ship. This is a highly cross-functional, high-ambiguity individual-contributor role suited to someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, product, dealmaking, and partner development, and who can build a business from zero to one and one to ten with limited guidance. The role also includes project management and operations, often where processes are not yet defined, so we need someone scrappy and proactive who finds ways to unblock problems we have not identified yet.

title: Senior Transition Manager
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

The Transition Manager is responsible for planning and delivering end-to-end transitions of various functions/capabilities activities from local markets or functions into Cencora‘s Global Business Services (CBS). The role requires strong program and project management capability, structured transition execution, and effective stakeholder management to ensure business continuity, service quality, and timely delivery of agreed transition outcomes.

The Transition Manager, CBS leads complex, high-impact operational transitions across geographies, teams, functions, vendors, or business units. This role is responsible for driving end-to-end transition strategy, planning, execution, and stabilization to ensure seamless implementation with minimal disruption to business operations. The individual partners with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to establish governance, manage risk, oversee operational readiness, and ensure successful handoff to steady-state operations. The role coordinates activities across markets, CBS centers, IT and operational teams to ensure a controlled and compliant transition into the GBS operating model.

• Lead complex, cross-functional global transition initiatives involving business process changes, operating model shifts, service migrations, or organizational realignment.

• Develop and execute comprehensive transition strategies, plans, milestones, dependencies, and governance structures.

• Partner with business leaders, functional teams, and external partners to define scope, roles, responsibilities, and success measures for transitions.

• Drive transition governance, including executive updates, decision forums, issue escalation, and progress reporting.

• Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, and lead mitigation and resolution planning.

• Coordinate knowledge transfer and process handoff activities to ensure business continuity and operational effectiveness.

• Validate operational readiness across people, processes, systems, controls, reporting, and support models before implementation.

• Monitor transition execution and stabilization activities to ensure service continuity, performance, and stakeholder satisfaction.

• Lead change management and communication efforts in partnership with key stakeholders to support adoption and readiness.

• Ensure all transition activities comply with internal policies, quality standards, business controls, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Analyze lessons learned and transition outcomes to recommend improvements to methodologies, governance, and operational practices.

• May provide guidance, coaching, or indirect leadership to less experienced team members.

• Perform related duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, project management, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

• Typically requires 6-10 years of experience in transition management, business operations, project management, program management, or related roles.

• Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional, global business transitions in complex environments.

• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience delivering GBS or shared services transitions.

Certifications

• Certification in Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI, PRINCE2, Agile methodology (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or SAFe Agile), continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma etc.), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or equivalent ce

The Platform Operations team at College Board builds solutions to help reimagine and elevate engineering practices around cloud infrastructure, architecture, networking, CI/CD, IaC, and developer experience. ABOUT THE ROLE

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Kochi, India
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.
What Yo u’ ll Do:

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity-driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Ciena is shaping the future of high-speed connectivity, and this role sits at the center of that momentum. As Advisor, Product Marketing, this position helps define how Ciena ’s electrical and optical high-speed interconnect portfolio is positioned, understood, and adopted across the global market. This is a highly visible opportunity to influence a fast-growing space, working across Product Line Management, Research and Development (R&D), Sales, and Marketing to translate advanced technology into compelling market impact.

How you will make an impact:
• Drive and support global go-to-market initiatives that accelerate adoption and market share growth for Ciena ’s high-speed interconnect offerings.
• Develop differentiated portfolio positioning grounded in market, customer, and competitive intelligence.
• Create compelling, audience-specific digital and field marketing content that builds demand and thought leadership.
• Influence mindshare by supporting external communications with partners, media, and industry analysts.
• Collaborate closely with Product Line Management, Marketing, and Sales to ensure alignment with business and corporate objectives.
• Partner with Research and Development (R&D) to ensure technical accuracy and clarity across all marketing materials.
• Support Ciena ’s presence at tradeshows, industry forums, and partner or analyst events.

The must haves:
• 7+ years of experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, or related roles within networking, telecommunications, or semiconductor industries.

• Strong understanding of data center architectures, including scale-up and scale-out applications.
• Proven ability to develop high-quality written content for technical and business audiences, including blogs, white papers, presentations, and case studies.
• Strong presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills across internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience working effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive initiatives to completion, and operate with minimal supervision.

Nice to haves:
• Experience supporting analyst relations or media engagement in a technology-driven market.
• Familiarity with hyperscale, cloud, or artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure ecosystems.
• Experience supporting industry events, conferences, or large-scale tradeshows.
• Background working closely with hardware engineering or silicon development teams.
• Comfort translating complex technical concepts into clear, market-facing narratives.

title: Senior Design Manager
description:
ABOUT INDUSTRIOUS

Industrious is the largest premium flexible workspace company in the world, operating over 250 locations across 10 countries as part of the CBRE portfolio. We design workplaces where teams feel welcomed, supported, and able to do their best work. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Design Manager, you will serve a critical role in delivering outstanding environments for our customers and innovating on the physical products we provide. You will work closely with other Design Managers, Product Development, as well as cross-functional Real Estate, Construction, Operations, and Launch teams to support the company's growth and development goals for new locations.

We're looking for a creative self-starter who works comfortably in ambiguous circumstances, proactively seeks solutions to issues, and is excited to have a voice in design and product conversations across the organization.

This role may be based in any US Industrious Hub Market (New York City, Boston, Washington DC, Chicago, Atlanta, Tampa, or Austin).

WHAT MIGHT YOUR DAY LOOK LIKE

Your day might start reviewing a test fit and blocking plan with Real Estate and Operations for a site in the pipeline. From there, you shift to overseeing construction documents and coordinating with external architects, engineers, and vendors to keep a project on budget and schedule. Part of the afternoon might go to specifying FF&E, artwork, and greenery for an upcoming launch, or coaching a Design Manager through a project decision. By the end of the day, you're looking at ways to improve your team's design workflows, or thinking through how an emerging design trend could shape future product standards.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Project Leadership: Oversee select projects through all phases of design, including Test Fit, SD, DD, CD, Construction Administration, and launch. Ensure that Industrious product standards and guidelines are followed in design decision-making, advocating for both our brand and design vision to landlord partners, while managing the quality of vendor outputs.

- Strategic Planning: Collaborate with Real Estate, Operations, and Construction on programming, blocking plans, and test fits.

- FF&E Oversight: Specify furniture, accessories, artwork, and greenery.

- Cross-Functional Coordination: Work collaboratively with Construction, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Operations, and Facilities, as well as external consultants and vendors.

- Process Improvements: Identify and implement opportunities to enhance design workflows and efficiency.

- Design Innovation: Identify design ideas, trends, and new product specifications to evolve our design standards and innovate our physical workplace products.

- Team Building: Build a positive culture on our growing team and have significant input to our design vision, strategy, and execution.

- People Management: Coach Design Managers and manage performance.

YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE

• 5+ years of experience in an actuarial, analytical, or finance role within a team-based environment

• Strong analytical and modeling skills using Excel or comparable modeling tools

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

Who we are looking for

You've spent 7-10+ years deep in commercial operations, GTM operations, or process excellence, and you've learned through hands-on experience that the gap between a well-designed process and a forgotten one usually comes down to adoption, documentation, and continuous reinforcement. You know Lean principles-process flow analysis, consistent procedures, cause investigation, and PDCA-not as theory but as tools you use daily. title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.

WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services. WELL Health Technologies, uses this platform to power healthcare practitioners both inside and outside of WELL Health Technologies’ own omni-channel patient services offerings.
WELL owns and operates Canada's largest network of outpatient medical clinics serving primary and specialized healthcare services and is the provider of a leading multi-national multi-disciplinary telehealth offering. WELL Health Technologies is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "WELL".
To learn more about the company, please visit: .
The opportunity
Reporting to the Senior Director, Digital Transformation, the Applied AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and optimize AI-powered applications and solutions that create measurable business value across the organization.
This is a hands-on engineering role focused on applying AI to real business challenges, not building foundation models. Working closely with business, data, and technology teams, you will take AI solutions from concept to production, delivering agents, assistants, automations, and applications that help teams work smarter and make better decisions.
You are a builder who enjoys solving complex problems, navigating ambiguity, and creating enterprise-ready solutions that people actually use. Joining WELL's growing Business Transformation team, you will help shape the future of AI across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations.
This is a fully remote role based anywhere in Canada, with a preference for candidates located in Toronto or Vancouver.
Who you are
You are an experienced software engineer and builder who has developed strong applied AI capabilities. You get energized by turning ideas into solutions that people actually use. Whether starting with a whiteboard sketch, a business challenge, or an emerging opportunity, you enjoy taking ownership of the entire journey, from design and development through deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
You combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity, creativity, and business acumen. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and enjoy working closely with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to achieve before determining the best technical path forward. While AI is your toolkit, your focus is always on solving real business problems and creating measurable value.
You thrive in environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity exists, and innovation is encouraged. Rather than waiting for perfect requirements, you are comfortable navigating complexity, connecting the dots, and building practical solutions that improve efficiency, support decision-making, and automate workflows.
Most importantly, you understand that successful AI solutions require more than great prompts. They require thoughtful integration, secure access to data, testing, monitoring, governance, and ongoing iteration. You have experience delivering solutions into production environments and understand what it takes to build systems that are reliable, scalable, and trusted by users.
What's in it for you
Build what’s next. This is an opportunity to help shape how AI is applied across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations. You will join a growing team that is building enterprise AI capabilities from the ground up, giving you the chance to contribute to high-impact initiatives and influence how the organization leverages AI in the years ahead.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend/Infrastructure
description:
About SimplicityDX
SimplicityDX (SDX) converts creator user-generated content (UGC) into structured, verified, agent-readable social proof for AI-powered commerce. We operate as infrastructure for the agentic commerce era, not as a content or marketing tool.
Our platform began by solving a real-time problem for the creator economy: as a creator’s post goes live, SDX ingests it, matches it against the brand’s product catalogue and the creator’s own media, and assembles a purpose-built storefront on the fly. The creator gets a single link to drop into their social call-to-action, and that link resolves to a shoppable experience built for that exact post.
We are now extending that same ingestion, verification, and assembly capability to a bigger problem: AI shopping agents (ChatGPT Shopping, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, and the frameworks that will follow them) can already retrieve structured product data - price, specs, availability. What they cannot do reliably is judge whether a product works for a specific person or use case. SDX’s verified creator UGC is built to close that gap: human-validated evidence, creator context, and use-case-specific claims that an AI agent can reason over rather than merely retrieve. Our mission is to make verified, trustworthy UGC a standard, queryable layer of the agentic web - available not just on our own storefronts, but to any AI chatbot or agent that shops on a consumer’s behalf.

Why Lisbon
Lisbon is our first office outside our current base, and this hire is one of the founding members of that team.
Early engineers here will have an outsized hand in how the office’s engineering culture, standards, and working practices take shape.

What You’ll Work On

• SDX engineers work across a pipeline that runs from raw creator content to something an AI agent can trust and act on. Depending on the role, that includes:
• Real-time ingestion - pulling and normalizing creator content across heterogeneous, constantly changing social platform APIs.
• Claim and evidence extraction - turning creator speech and video into structured, verifiable product claims, and linking each claim to the specific timestamped clip that supports it.
• Verification infrastructure - the pipelines and tooling behind our multi-layer human verification process, which produces the confidence signals that make our data trustworthy to both shoppers and AI agents.
• Storefront and evidence-page assembly - dynamically building shoppable storefronts and structured evidence documents (schema.org, custom SDX schema types) from a blend of brand catalogues and creator UGC.
• Distribution to AI surfaces - exposing verified UGC through commerce feeds (e.g. Google Merchant Center) and through direct agent-facing interfaces such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoints, so AI shopping agents can query our data at inference time.
This is genuine infrastructure work - real-time systems, structured data and schema design, integrations with commerce and social platforms, and building for consumption by AI agents rather than only human browsers - not content tooling or campaign management.

How We Work: Embracing an AI-Native Engineering Culture

• SDX is deliberately building an AI-native engineering culture, and we want that reflected in how the team works day to day, not just in what we build for customers.
• We expect engineers to work comfortably with an AI coding agent that is integrated directly into our codebase and issue tracker - using it to scaffold, implement, refactor, investigate, and triage as a normal part of the job, not as a novelty.
• We care most about judgment: knowing what to hand to an AI agent, what to keep for careful human review, and when a task looks safe for AI to handle but actually isn’t. That judgment call - made pragmatically, case by case - matters more to us than raw familiarity with any one tool.
• Because our product itself is about verifying and trusting AI-consumed content, we hold our own engineering

title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Data Platform

ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

The AISim division is looking for a seasoned Product Manager to join this team to build and own the Data Platform that underpins AISim’s scientific discovery platform spanning Drug Discovery (BioSim) and Materials Design (ChemSim) applications. This includes the data lifecycle including how data is ingested from CROs and lab partners, automatically detected and reconciled, tracked end-to-end for lineage and provenance, ingested into knowledge graphs for use by scientists and agents, and governed by sensitivity and field-of-use controls. Your charter spans the full journey of a dataset; from the moment it lands to the moment it is safely used in a model or exported as certifiable evidence.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you’ll lead through product craft and cross-functional influence, partnering closely with engineering, science, design, and trust/compliance. We’re customer-obsessed in practice and all platform decisions trace back to real internal and partner needs. We value collaborative problem solving, ownership, transparent communication, and humility.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define and own the Data Platform roadmap across ingestion, auto-detection, schema reconciliation, and lineage

- Define and own the Knowledge Graph strategy and execution within AISim

- Own the CRO and lab-partner ingestion-template product and the auto-matching UX, so partner data is usable the moment it lands

Title: D365 CE Functional Consultant

Location: Remote

Description 

The D365 CE Functional Consultant gathers requirements, documents business processes, configures Dynamics 365 CE and Power Platform capabilities, supports testing and training, and helps clients adopt practical CRM/CX solutions. Senior-level consultants are expected to own defined workstreams with limited oversight and guide junior resources where appropriate. 

Core responsibilities 

• Participate in discovery and design sessions to capture business requirements, current-state process issues, future-state process needs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and configuration decisions. 

• Configure D365 CE and Power Platform features including model-driven apps, tables, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, business process flows, queues, routing, security roles, and basic automation. 

• Support Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, and related CE/CX capabilities depending on project scope and specialization. 

• Prepare functional design documents, process flows, configuration workbooks, test scripts, training materials, and user adoption content. 

• Maintain requirements traceability from discovery notes to user stories, functional design decisions, configuration workbooks, test scripts, UAT outcomes, and training/adoption materials. 

• Support backlog refinement, sprint demos, CRP/UAT planning, test execution, defect triage, release readiness, go-live support, and hypercare activities. 

• Partner with technical consultants on integrations, data migration, reporting, security, and custom extension requirements. 

• Help clients evaluate standard functionality versus customization and escalate scope, adoption, data, and process risks early. 

• Maintain awareness of Microsoft Copilot, embedded intelligence, Power BI, and automation capabilities that can improve user productivity and customer experience. 

Required skills and experience 

• 3+ years’ experience implementing or supporting Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, or comparable CRM platforms. 

• Working knowledge of Dataverse, model-driven apps, Power Automate, dashboards, basic reporting, Microsoft 365 integration, and user security concepts. 

• Ability to produce clear documentation, manage assigned work, communicate status, and collaborate effectively with clients and internal teams. 

• Understanding of agile delivery, user stories, acceptance criteria, test management, training, and change/adoption fundamentals. 

• Recommended certifications: PL-200; MB-280, MB-230, MB-240, or relevant CE module certifications preferred.

The CE Practice at MCA sits at the forefront of the firm’s innovation and growth strategy. We help organizations reimagine how they connect with customers by combining business transformation, modern cloud platforms, and AI-driven capabilities. Leveraging the Microsoft ecosystem - including Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and emerging AI technologies - our team designs customer engagement solutions that drive better experiences and stronger commercial outcomes. We are a collaborative, fast-growing team passionate about innovation, human-centered design, and building the next generation
